purpose: Authoring inventory for factual coverage. It maps factual families to real profile consumers; it neither authorizes presence nor defines an action, item, recipe, NPC, or location whitelist.
claim_coverage_rule: Every production claim is explicitly classified into one or more semantic families with location and resource/material/process/NPC applicability. Domain rollups and source inventory are informational cross-checks, not substitutes for family classification. Coverage of existing claims is not completeness of all gameplay knowledge.
